name: ebus-notebook
description: Notebook for eBUS activities using ebus-typespec and an optional ebusd/micro-ebusd instance.

commands.title: Create New eBUS TypeSpec file from Template
Convert eBUS TypeSpec to ebusd/micro-ebusd and test
Toggle query for user input on upload to ebusd/micro-ebusd

ebus-notebook.conversion.show.title: Conversion Visibility
ebus-notebook.conversion.show.description: Whether to show the conversion process output or use a task instead of a terminal.

ebus-notebook.conversion.cmd.title: Conversion Command for ebusd
ebus-notebook.conversion.cmd.markdownDescription: The command to use for converting [TypeSpec to ebusd CSV](https://github.com/john30/ebus-typespec).

ebus-notebook.conversion.micro-ebusd-cmd.title: Conversion Command for micro-ebusd
ebus-notebook.conversion.micro-ebusd-cmd.markdownDescription: The command to use for converting [TypeSpec to ebusd](https://github.com/john30/ebus-typespec) and uploading to micro-ebusd.

ebus-notebook.ebusd.micro-ebusd-mode.title: micro-ebusd mode
ebus-notebook.ebusd.micro-ebusd-mode.markdownDescription: Whether the host is micro-ebusd (instead of ebusd) and if so, whether to use inline mode.

ebus-notebook.ebusd.host.title: ebusd/micro-ebusd Host
ebus-notebook.ebusd.host.markdownDescription: The host name or IP address of [ebusd](https://github.com/john30/ebusd/wiki/3.1.-TCP-client-commands) or micro-ebusd to connect to (use "https://<host-or-ip>" for SSL).

ebus-notebook.ebusd.port.title: ebusd REPL Port
ebus-notebook.ebusd.port.markdownDescription: The port number of [ebusd REPL](https://github.com/john30/ebusd/wiki/3.1.-TCP-client-commands) to connect to (irrelevant for micro-ebusd mode).

ebus-notebook.ebusd.read.title: ebusd read Command
ebus-notebook.ebusd.read.markdownDescription: The command to use for issuing a read of a generated definition on ebusd. User input is asked for when convert+test command is issued with '-i' as first argument. See [read command](https://github.com/john30/ebusd/wiki/3.1.-TCP-client-commands#read). Wildcards "${input}" and "${line}" are replaced with the actual input and conversion result line values.

ebus-notebook.ebusd.micro-ebusd-read.title: micro-ebusd read Command
ebus-notebook.ebusd.micro-ebusd-read.markdownDescription: The command to use for issuing a read of a previously uploaded definition on micro-ebusd. User input is asked for when convert+test command is issued with '-i' as first argument. Wildcards "${input}", "${circuit}", and "${name}" are replaced with the actual input and conversion result values.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run package-vsix
